Company Description: MUSHEEZ® helps European food, beverage and food supplement companies source functional mushroom ingredients and bring finished products to market through flexible white label and private label production. Based in Estonia, MUSHEEZ® works with specialist cultivation, extraction and manufacturing partners, while managing ingredient selection, quality control, independent testing, documentation and practical project support. We support established brands, emerging companies, distributors, retailers, contract manufacturers and product developers. A client may come to MUSHEEZ® for a single bulk ingredient, a ready-to-sell white label product, a customised private label project, or support selecting the most appropriate mushroom material for a new formulation. WHITE LABEL AND PRIVATE LABEL FUNCTIONAL MUSHROOM PRODUCTS Available formats include: • Alcohol-free liquid mushroom extracts • Mushroom extract powders • Capsules • Tinctures • Functional mushroom formulations Typical starting minimum order quantities can be as low as 48 bottles for selected liquid products, 50 units for powders and 70 units for capsules or tinctures. White label provides a fast route to market using established products and packaging. Private label allows greater flexibility around formulation, ingredients, packaging and presentation, with minimum order quantities depending on the level of customisation. MUSHEEZ® can support the process from product and ingredient selection through manufacturing coordination, quality documentation and ongoing commercial supply. FUNCTIONAL MUSHROOM INGREDIENTSOur core species are: Lion’s Mane | Reishi | Chaga | Cordyceps CS-4 | Maitake | Shiitake Depending on the species and intended application, available formats include raw mushroom powders, processed 1:1 powders, concentrated water extracts, dual extracts and liquid ingredients. MUSHEEZ® does not believe that a larger extraction ratio automatically means a better ingredient. Selection should instead reflect what the client is making, the intended use level, processing requirements, regulatory position, sensory considerations and commercial objectives. This is particularly important because mushroom ingredients sold under the same common name can differ considerably in fungal material, production method, concentration, composition and intended use. PUREMUSHROOM™ VERIFIED INGREDIENTSPureMushroom™ is the MUSHEEZ® range for clients who want stronger evidence around ingredient identity, purity, composition and batch consistency. The range includes selected Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Chaga, Cordyceps CS-4, Maitake and Shiitake ingredients. Depending on the ingredient and batch, the MUSHEEZ® verification programme can include: • Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) identity analysis • Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry Quadrupole Time-of-Flight (LC-MS-QTOF) compound profiling • Alpha-glucan and beta-glucan analysis • Microbiological testing • Heavy metals testing • Physical and functional testing PureMushroom™ ingredients are primarily based on the fruiting body. Chaga uses the conk, while PureCordyceps™ CS-4 is produced from fermented mycelium. Batch-level information is made available through PureData™, allowing clients to look beyond extraction ratios and supplier specification claims when comparing mushroom ingredients. SOLVIQA™ FOR FOOD AND BEVERAGE DEVELOPMENTSOLVIQA™ launches at Fi Europe 2026 and is being developed specifically for food and beverage applications. The range focuses on the practical behaviour of mushroom ingredients in formulations, not only their chemical specification. Initial SOLVIQA™ ingredients include selected Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Maitake and Shiitake extracts. Evaluation can include: • Water Solubility Index • Water-Holding Capacity • Oil-Holding Capacity • Dispersion behaviour • Sensory characteristics • Suitability for different food and beverage matrices This information can help research and development teams identify formulation issues earlier and select ingredients according to the actual application. Potential applications include ready-to-drink beverages, drink powders, hot drinks, savoury products and other functional foods. QUALITY CONTROL AND INDEPENDENT TESTINGMUSHEEZ® combines specialist external manufacturing with its own quality control and verification programme. We distinguish clearly between information supplied by a manufacturer and analysis independently commissioned by MUSHEEZ®. Testing is selected according to the ingredient and the question that needs answering. No single analytical method provides every answer. For example, Nuclear Magnetic Resonance can provide strong evidence around chemical identity and composition, while Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry Quadrupole Time-of-Flight can provide detailed compound profiling. Enzymatic methods are used for glucan analysis, while microbiological and heavy metals testing address different aspects of product safety and specification. For food and beverage projects, analytical data may also be combined with physical performance measurements and trained sensory evaluation. The objective is practical: to give procurement teams, product developers and brand owners better information about what they are buying and how an ingredient may perform. EUROPEAN REGULATORY AWARENESSFunctional mushrooms do not all have the same regulatory position in the European Union. Suitability depends on factors including species, fungal material, processing method and intended application. Selected Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Maitake and Shiitake ingredients can be suitable for conventional food and food supplement applications. MUSHEEZ® supplies Chaga and Cordyceps CS-4 for food supplement use only. MUSHEEZ® therefore considers the intended product and market before recommending an ingredient route. PRACTICAL EUROPEAN SUPPORTMUSHEEZ® is built around making specialist mushroom sourcing and product development more accessible. Our model allows clients to work with a European team while drawing on specialist production capabilities from different manufacturing partners. This gives us flexibility to select production methods and suppliers according to the ingredient rather than requiring every project to fit one factory. MUSHEEZ® currently supports more than 60 brands across around 30 countries. Our clients include food supplement brands, functional food and beverage developers, distributors, contract manufacturers and retailers. RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL RESOURCESMUSHEEZ® publishes technical reports, articles and selected research openly to help improve transparency and decision-making within the functional mushroom industry. Company Description: Founded in Milan in 1947, SACMAR is an independent Italian company specialising in flavours, food solutions, essential oils, botanical extracts and aromatic raw materials. Customers are supported throughout the development process with co-development, benchmark adaptation, reverse engineering, application testing, analytical control, regulatory assistance and contract manufacturing. Around 30% of the SACMAR team is dedicated to technical activities, ensuring responsive, flexible and application-focused support. Company Description: Biova® is a science‑driven ingredient company specializing in the 100% US made and sourced, sustainable upcycling of egg membrane into clinically studied, high‑value bioactive ingredients for human and pet health. Founded on the belief that nature, when unlocked through innovation, can deliver powerful health solutions, Biova transforms a previously discarded natural resource into differentiated ingredients supported by research, quality, and traceability. At the core of Biova’s platform is its proprietary, patented process for isolating egg membrane—an exceptionally rich source of naturally occurring collagen, elastin, hyaluronic acid, glycosaminoglycans, and other structural proteins and peptides essential to connective tissue health. Unlike traditional eggshell‑derived materials, Biova’s egg membrane is carefully separated and processed to preserve its complex biological matrix, resulting in highly functional ingredients with broad application potential. Biova’s ingredients have been studied across multiple health categories, including joint comfort and mobility, skin and beauty from within, topical skin care, and pet health. While individual studies may reference different trade names or applications, they are unified by a single foundational ingredient platform—one that allows brand partners to innovate across formats and markets with confidence. Sustainability and transparency are central to Biova’s mission. By upcycling egg membrane from the US food supply, Biova reduces waste while creating measurable value for formulators and brands. All ingredients are produced in the United States, with rigorous quality standards, strong supply chain controls, and documentation designed to support regulatory and commercial success globally. Today, Biova partners with leading brands worldwide, providing not just ingredients, but a science‑backed innovation platform that enables differentiation, storytelling, and long‑term growth at the intersection of nutrition, beauty, and wellness.

Company Description: Breko is a leading supplier of wines, spirits, food and health ingredients, as well as raw materials for cosmetic applications and animal nutrition. Headquartered in Germany, the company has built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and long-term partnerships across international markets. Over the past years, Breko has successfully expanded and repositioned its business in the health ingredient sector, becoming a recognized distributor of scientifically supported ingredients for dietary supplements, functional foods, beverages, and wellness products. At Breko, quality, sustainability, and transparency are at the core of everything we do. We carefully select our suppliers and manufacturing partners based not only on product quality but also on their commitment to responsible sourcing, environmental stewardship, and full traceability throughout the supply chain. We believe that high-quality products can only be achieved through long-term partnerships with companies that share our values and passion for excellence. Our sourcing strategy prioritizes ingredients of European origin wherever possible. Today, approximately 98% of our portfolio is harvested, cultivated, or manufactured in Europe. This approach enables us to ensure short supply chains, consistent quality standards, reliable availability, and compliance with European regulatory requirements. In addition, we place a strong emphasis on organically certified ingredients and sustainable agricultural practices whenever suitable options are available. Breko serves customers across multiple industries, including the food and beverage sector, dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, functional foods, cosmetics, animal nutrition, and pet health. Through close cooperation with internationally recognized manufacturers and research-driven companies, we offer innovative ingredient solutions that help our customers develop differentiated products supported by science, quality, and market relevance. For more than two decades, Breko has specialized in premium polyphenol ingredients, making this category one of the company's core competencies. Polyphenols are among the most extensively researched plant-derived bioactive compounds due to their contribution to healthy aging, cardiovascular wellness, metabolic health, cognitive function, and overall vitality. Through continuous collaboration with leading manufacturers and researchers, Breko has established one of the most comprehensive portfolios of polyphenol-rich ingredients available in the European market. Recognizing the growing consumer demand for scientifically substantiated wellness ingredients, Breko continually evaluates and introduces innovative products backed by clinical research and robust quality standards. The company's objective is not merely to distribute ingredients but to provide complete solution concepts that enable customers to accelerate product development and bring meaningful innovations to market. A central element of this portfolio is the range of grape, wine, and olive-derived extracts produced by our long-standing French partner GRAP’SUD. These extracts are sourced from carefully selected Mediterranean raw materials and standardized to provide consistent levels of valuable polyphenols. The product range includes grape seed extracts rich in oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), red wine extracts, grape skin extracts, and olive fruit extracts, all designed for use in dietary supplements, functional foods, beverages, and cosmetic formulations.To complement these naturally derived polyphenol ingredients, Breko offers Veri-te™, a highly pure trans-resveratrol produced via precision yeast fermentation. Veri-te™ is one of the most scientifically documented resveratrol ingredients available on the market and is supported by numerous human clinical studies investigating healthy aging, cardiovascular health, cognitive performance, and metabolic wellness. Fermentation-based production provides exceptional purity, consistency, sustainability, and scalability while eliminating the agricultural limitations associated with botanical extraction. Another innovation within the portfolio is VinoFit+®, a proprietary ingredient formulation developed to combine selected red wine polyphenols with resveratrol. VinoFit+® was designed to capture the beneficial polyphenol profile traditionally associated with moderate red wine consumption while completely eliminating alcohol intake. The ingredient offers manufacturers a convenient and science-oriented solution for the development of capsules, tablets, sachets, gummies, beverages, and functional food products targeting healthy aging and cardiovascular wellness. Our portfolio includes a broad range of European berry extracts such as bilberry, aronia, tart cherry, blackcurrant, and elderberry, valued for their naturally occurring anthocyanins and polyphenols. In addition, we offer premium pine bark extracts with high OPC content, providing powerful antioxidant and vascular health support. In addition to polyphenols, Breko distributes Fibersol®-2, a highly soluble digestion-resistant maltodextrin widely used as a functional dietary fiber. Fibersol®-2 offers outstanding formulation flexibility and excellent sensory characteristics, making it particularly suitable for beverages, powders, bars, gummies, and nutritional products. The ingredient is supported by extensive scientific research investigating digestive health, glycemic response, and satiety support. Due to its excellent solubility and neutral taste profile, Fibersol®-2 represents an ideal complementary ingredient for polyphenol-enriched beverage and nutritional formulations.Breko's expertise extends beyond ingredient distribution. We actively support our customers throughout the entire product development process, including ingredient selection, formulation concepts, technical documentation, quality requirements, and market-specific regulatory considerations. Our team combines commercial experience with scientific knowledge to help customers identify ingredients that align with current consumer trends and evolving market demands. The company maintains a strong focus on scientific credibility. When selecting new products, Breko prioritizes ingredients supported by robust analytical characterization, standardized production processes, and, whenever possible, human clinical research. This commitment enables customers to build innovative product concepts on a foundation of quality, transparency, and scientific substantiation. As market trends continue to evolve toward preventive health, healthy aging, gut health, sustainability, and plant-based nutrition, Breko remains committed to identifying and supplying ingredients that meet the needs of both manufacturers and consumers. Our growing portfolio reflects the increasing demand for natural, evidence-based solutions that support health and wellbeing in everyday life. Today, Breko is regarded as a trusted partner for manufacturers seeking premium ingredients with European quality standards, transparent supply chains, and strong scientific foundations. Through close relationships with leading producers, a focus on sustainability, and more than 20 years of expertise in polyphenols and health ingredients, Breko continues to help customers create innovative products that meet the highest expectations of the modern marketplace. Breko GmbH – Bringing together science, sustainability, and premium European ingredients for food, health, wellness, and beauty.

Company Description: Horphag Research is a global leader in the research, development and commercialization of clinically studied, science-backed botanical ingredients for the nutraceutical, food supplement and beauty-from-within industries. Company Description: LUK Botanik is a manufacturer of high-value botanical ingredients for the food, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries. Production is carried out in controlled cleanroom environments, supported by our in-house laboratory and quality-control systems. Our solvent-free, low-temperature and zero-waste process enables environmentally responsible production while delivering clean, consistent ingredients with full traceability from raw material to final product. Our portfolio includes plant proteins, botanical extracts, oleoresins, specialty oils, hydroalcoholic extracts and water-soluble powders. Our supercritical CO₂ extract portfolio includes rosemary and thyme extracts developed for use in food, nutraceutical and personal care formulations. Through controlled extraction and downstream processing, we can tailor the concentration and composition of selected botanical compounds according to the intended application. Product quality and consistency are verified through our in-house analytical capabilities, including HPLC, GC-MS and UV-Vis analysis. Depending on the product and application, we evaluate key parameters such as active and marker compound profiles, protein content, physicochemical properties and microbiological quality. Each production stage is closely monitored to ensure reliable specifications and batch-to-batch consistency. Supported by dedicated R&D and technical expertise, we also develop tailor-made ingredients to meet specific formulation, concentration and application requirements. From plant proteins to specialised CO₂ extracts, LUK Botanik provides manufacturers with traceable, application-ready botanical ingredients backed by science, technology and quality control.

Company Description: Meatafora is a B2B food-tech company developing next-generation functional fat and ingredient solutions for the global food industry. Our technologies are designed to help food manufacturers create healthier, more sustainable products without compromising the functionality, sensory experience, or manufacturing performance consumers and producers expect from conventional fats. At the core of Meatafora’s portfolio is our proprietary plant-based structured fat platform, developed to provide the functionality of animal fat, butter, and conventional solid fats while significantly improving their nutritional profile. Fat is much more than an ingredient, it determines texture, juiciness, mouthfeel, structure, flavor release, melting behavior, and processing performance. Replacing animal fat, butter, palm, coconut, or other conventional solid fats therefore requires more than simply replacing one oil with another. Meatafora engineers fat functionality. Our platform enables us to tailor key characteristics such as hardness, elasticity, melting profile, texture, appearance, and fat retention according to the requirements of the final product and manufacturing process. This allows us to develop application-specific solutions rather than offering a single generic fat substitute. Broad application potential Meatafora’s structured fat technology is being developed and evaluated across multiple food categories, including: Butter replacement and bakery – delivering the structure, plasticity and melting behavior required for butter-type applications. Laminated pastries – targeting demanding applications such as croissants and puff pastry, where fat structure and behavior during lamination and baking are critical. Creams, fillings and spreads – enabling customizable texture, stability and mouthfeel. Meat and processed meat products – supporting juiciness, fat retention, texture and sensory quality while enabling healthier fat profiles. Plant-based and hybrid meat – providing structured fat functionality and an alternative to conventional coconut- and palm-based fat systems. Cultivated meat – providing a scalable functional fat component that can complement cultivated cells and tissues. Healthier fat without sacrificing performance Meatafora’s technology is designed to enable lower saturated fat, zero trans fat, no cholesterol, and sustainability while maintaining the physical and sensory properties required by the food application. The platform is plant-based and can be formulated for different nutritional, functional and product requirements. Importantly, it is designed to address one of the food industry's biggest challenges: improving the nutritional profile of fat without losing the performance of conventional solid fats. Designed for industry Meatafora is moving beyond laboratory development toward industrial scale-up and commercialization. Our technology is being adapted for scalable production and integration into existing food manufacturing processes. We work directly with food companies to understand the requirements of each application and tailor the fat accordingly, from melting temperature and firmness to moisture retention and processing behavior. This makes Meatafora not simply a fat supplier, but a technology and development partner for manufacturers seeking a functional fat solution customized to their product. Beyond fat: enabling next-generation food productionMeatafora is also developing complementary technologies for the cultivated and next-generation food industries, including edible plant-based microcarriers for cell cultivation and proprietary bovine cell line. Together, these capabilities position Meatafora as an enabling technology company supporting both today's food manufacturers and the emerging cultivated food industry. We are looking for partnerswe are interested in meeting: Food manufacturers, meat processors, bakery and pastry manufacturers, butter and dairy-alternative producers, plant-based and hybrid food companies, cultivated meat companies, ingredient companies, distributors, contract manufacturers, strategic partners and investors. Whether you are looking to replace animal fat, butter, coconut oil, palm-based fats or conventional solid fats; reduce saturated fat; improve juiciness and fat retention; develop a better butter alternative; or create a customized fat system for a new product, we would be happy to explore how Meatafora’s technology can fit your application. Meatafora – engineering the functionality of fat for the next generation of food.

Company Description: Millmax – European Contract Manufacturer of Food Supplements, Sports Nutrition & Cosmetics Millmax is an EU-based contract manufacturer and private label partner for food supplements, sports nutrition and cosmetic products, with manufacturing and product development facilities in Riga, Latvia. We work with established brands, retailers, distributors and growing consumer brands across Europe and international markets, supporting projects from product formulation and R&D through manufacturing, filling, packaging and commercial production. Our approach combines flexible European manufacturing, in-house product development, quality control and a broad range of packaging capabilities. Millmax can support both the development of new custom formulations and the production of existing customer formulations, as well as selected white label and private label products. Food Supplement & Sports Nutrition Manufacturing Millmax manufactures dietary supplements and sports nutrition products in two core formats: Powders Sports nutrition powders Creatine monohydrate Pre-workout formulations BCAA and EAA amino acid blends Electrolyte powders Collagen formulations Plant-based protein powders Functional powder blends Mushroom and botanical blends Vitamin and mineral powder formulations Functional coffee and wellness blends Our powder manufacturing capabilities include ingredient weighing, blending, filling and packaging for both single-ingredient products and complex multi-ingredient formulations. Hard Capsules We manufacture HPMC and gelatin hard capsules in sizes #00, #0 and #1. Projects can range from straightforward single-ingredient supplements to more complex vitamin, mineral, botanical and functional formulations. Capsules can be supplied in bottles, jars, doypacks or blister packaging depending on the project requirements. Flexible Supplement Packaging Millmax offers a range of packaging solutions for food supplements and sports nutrition products. Powder products can be filled into PET jars, HDPE or PP containers, stand-up pouches, flat-bottom doypacks and single-dose sachets. Packaging sizes and configurations are selected according to the formulation, serving size, product volume and target market. Our standard PET packaging includes commonly used 500 ml, 750 ml and 1,000 ml formats, while larger formats are available depending on the product. For brands looking for convenient single-serving formats, Millmax also provides powder sachet filling and 4-side sealed sachet packaging. Hard capsules can be packed into plastic or glass bottles and jars, doypacks and blister packs. We work with packaging suppliers across Europe and can also evaluate custom packaging solutions for individual projects. Contract Manufacturing, Private Label & White Label Different customers require different levels of manufacturing support. Millmax can work as a full-service contract manufacturing partner, managing the process from formulation and raw material sourcing through manufacturing and packaging. We can also operate as a manufacturing and co-packing partner where the customer supplies its own raw materials, proprietary formulation, packaging components, labels or printed packaging. For customers seeking faster market entry, we offer selected white label supplement formulations that can be adapted to the required packaging and branding. This flexible model makes Millmax suitable for established supplement brands as well as companies launching new product ranges or looking for an additional European manufacturing partner. Product Development & R&D Product development is an important part of our manufacturing service. Our in-house R&D team works with customers on: New supplement formulation development Existing formula optimisation Ingredient selection and sourcing Flavour development Sweetener systems Powder solubility and sensory characteristics Capsule formulation Manufacturing feasibility Packaging selection Pilot and sample production Scale-up from laboratory formulation to commercial manufacturing Customers can bring us a finished specification or simply a product concept. Our team can then evaluate the project and determine the most suitable development and manufacturing route. Quality & European Manufacturing Millmax manufactures in Latvia, European Union, operating under established food safety and quality management procedures. Our food supplement manufacturing operations work according to GMP and HACCP requirements, with quality control integrated into the manufacturing process. Raw materials and finished products are controlled according to agreed specifications, and additional laboratory testing can be arranged depending on the formulation and customer requirements. We work with European and international raw material suppliers and can source both standard and branded ingredients depending on availability, project requirements and commercial volumes. Customers are welcome to visit our manufacturing facilities in Riga and conduct supplier qualification or manufacturing audits. Co-Packing & Filling Services In addition to full contract manufacturing, Millmax provides co-packing, filling, repacking and secondary packaging services. This can be particularly relevant for companies that already own their formulation or ingredients but require an EU manufacturing partner for: Powder blending Powder filling Capsule filling Bottle and jar filling Doypack filling Sachet filling Blister packaging Labelling Cartoning Repacking and secondary packaging This allows customers to retain control of their ingredients and supply chain while using Millmax for European production and packaging. Cosmetics Manufacturing Alongside nutraceutical manufacturing, Millmax operates a dedicated cosmetics development and manufacturing facility. Our cosmetic capabilities include development and production of: Face and body creams Facial serums Gels Hair and scalp serums Shampoos and conditioners Body care products Foot and leg care products Toners and sprays Oils and other leave-on cosmetic formulations Our cosmetics operation works according to ISO 22716 / Cosmetic GMP principles, with in-house formulation development and laboratory capabilities. Packaging options include tubes, jars, bottles, pumps, airless packaging and glass serum bottles. Millmax has also invested in automated tube filling and cartoning capabilities for larger commercial projects. From Concept to Commercial Production Our goal is not simply to fill containers. We aim to become a practical long-term manufacturing partner for our customers. Depending on the project, Millmax can support: Concept → Formulation → Ingredient Sourcing → Samples → Manufacturing → Quality Control → Filling → Packaging → Commercial Production Standard manufacturing projects can start from approximately 1,000–2,000 units per SKU, depending on formulation, packaging and production technology, making Millmax suitable for both growing brands and established companies requiring larger recurring production volumes. We particularly welcome long-term B2B partnerships with companies looking for a reliable European supplement manufacturer, additional manufacturing capacity, a second-source production partner, private label development or flexible co-packing services. Company Description: Oterra is a global provider of naturally sourced colors for the food and beverage industry, dedicated to helping manufacturers create visually appealing products. With roots dating back to 1876, the company combines 150 years of color expertise with advanced scientific knowledge, deep application expertise, and global supply chain capabilities to deliver innovative natural color solutions to customers around the world. Oterra's mission is to make natural colors accessible and easy to use for food and beverage manufacturers, so they can meet growing consumer demand for clean-label products while maintaining outstanding performance, consistency, and visual appeal. Headquartered in Denmark, Oterra serves customers across more than 110 markets through a global network of production facilities, laboratories, innovation centers, and commercial offices. The company supports more than 2,200 customers worldwide and has around1,240 people from more than 40 nationalities. With approximately 40 locations globally and a strong regional presence across all continents, Oterra combines global reach with local expertise to provide tailored solutions that address the unique regulatory, cultural, and consumer requirements of different markets. Oterra develops colors from fruits, vegetables, plants, algae and other naturally occurring raw materials to create vibrant color solutions that help brands reduce or eliminate artificial colors from their products. Its portfolio includes colors derived from ingredients such as black carrot, beetroot, turmeric, paprika, spirulina, grape skin, red radish, fruit concentrates, annatto, elderberry, and sweet potato. This extensive raw material expertise enables Oterra to deliver a broad palette of shades ranging from bright yellows and oranges to deep reds, purples, blues, greens, browns, black and white shades. The company offers one of the most extensive natural color portfolios in the industry, featuring more than 1,200 products, more than 30 natural pigments. Oterra's products are designed to perform across a wide variety of food and beverage segments, including beverages, confectionery, bakery, dairy, ice cream, snacks, prepared foods, cereals, plant-based products, dietary supplements and pet food. The company's technical teams work closely with customers to ensure that color solutions deliver the desired appearance while maintaining stability under various processing conditions, including exposure to heat, light, acidity levels and oxygen. What sets Oterra apart is its deep application expertise. The company recognizes that successful color development requires more than access to raw materials. Food manufacturing processes, product matrices, packaging formats, and consumer expectations all influence color performance. Oterra brings together specialists in color science, food technology, regulatory affairs, sensory science, analytical chemistry, formulation and market trends to collaborate with customers throughout the product development process. This combination of scientific excellence and commercial understanding allows Oterra to translate complex technical requirements into market-ready solutions. Research and development play a central role in Oterra's growth strategy. The company continuously invests in developing new products, improving existing technologies, and identifying new natural color sources that can help customers respond to changing market demands. Oterra's innovation efforts focus on delivering brighter shades, greater processing stability, improved sustainability, enhanced clean-label credentials, and regulatory compliance across global markets. Through its technical centers and innovation facilities, the company partners with customers to accelerate product development and reduce the complexity of transitioning from synthetic to natural colors. Oterra also benefits from a highly integrated supply chain model. The company manages critical aspects of the value chain from plant breeding and agricultural development through extraction, processing, manufacturing, quality assurance, and customer support. This backward-integrated approach allows greater control over quality, traceability, supply security, and sustainability. By working closely with farmers and agricultural partners worldwide, Oterra helps secure reliable access to high-quality raw materials while promoting responsible farming practices and long-term environmental stewardship. Sustainability is a fundamental pillar of Oterra's corporate strategy and long-term vision. Company Description: The Protein Brewery is a science-backed ingredients company based in Breda, the Netherlands, committed to reshaping the future of nutrition through sustainable, nutrient-dense, animal-free ingredients. Founded in 2020, the company harnesses advanced biomass fermentation to produce FERMOTEIN®, its flagship ingredient. FERMOTEIN® is a whole-food ingredient developed for active nutrition, longevity, and supplements. Conventional protein sources, whether animal-based or plant-based, rarely deliver complete nutrition in a single ingredient. FERMOTEIN® is a nutrient-dense, low-footprint alternative made from mycelium, the root structure of fungi. It delivers complete protein (PDCAAS 1.0, all essential amino acids), prebiotic fibre, micronutrients, and unique fungal bioactives. Its neutral taste and smell make it highly versatile across ready-to-mix powders, drinks, bars and supplement formats. What truly sets FERMOTEIN® apart is its unique composition. It contains more than 1,600 mg/kg of spermidine, a compound linked to cellular health and longevity, roughly 7 times the level found in wheat germ. This opens up possibilities for products targeting healthy ageing, sports and active nutrition, gut health and metabolic health. In 2026, FERMOTEIN® became the first whole-food mycelium ingredient authorised for sale in the EU under the Novel Food Regulation, with five years of data exclusivity. It is also cleared for sale in the U.S. and Singapore. From an innovation perspective, FERMOTEIN® is the result of intensive strain selection and production optimisation. Company Description: B.ROOT.LAB is a biotechnology company dedicated to developing sustainable, high-value functional ingredients from microalgae through advanced cultivation, extraction, purification, and standardization technologies. Inspired by the ocean—the origin of life—we combine scientific innovation with environmentally responsible manufacturing to create natural bio-based ingredients for the global food, nutraceutical, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and biotechnology industries. This technology provides a reliable supply of functional ingredients while contributing to carbon neutrality and sustainable bio-manufacturing. Our core portfolio includes Spirulina, Phycocyanin, Coelastrella, and Haematococcus, together with their bioactive compounds such as natural proteins, carotenoids, and astaxanthin. These ingredients are developed for a wide range of applications including health supplements, functional foods, natural colorants, cosmetics, dermaceuticals, and other next-generation bio-based products. Beyond ingredient manufacturing, B.ROOT.LAB provides comprehensive B2B partnership solutions covering strain development, large-scale cultivation, ingredient extraction and purification, functional verification, formulation support, regulatory assistance, and OEM/ODM collaboration. By working closely with global partners, we accelerate the commercialization of innovative products while delivering customized solutions tailored to specific market needs. Driven by continuous research and development, intellectual property, and sustainable innovation, B.ROOT.LAB is building the next-generation microalgae bio-platform that connects science, nature, and industry. Our mission is to provide safe, reliable, and sustainable functional ingredients that improve human health while creating a better future for our planet.
